parts.text: What would you observe when compound **P** is reacted with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine (2,4-DNPH)?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Compound **U** contains a chiral centre and has the same molecular formula as compound **P**, $\text{C}_5\text{H}_8\text{O}$.

- Compound **U** readily decolourises a sample of bromine water.
- Compound **U** does not show cis-trans isomerism.
- When compound **U** is heated under reflux in the presence of excess acidified potassium dichromate(VI), the organic product gives the infra-red spectrum shown.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

Use the information given to suggest a structure for compound **U**. Explain your answer.
